profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at AppFolio, Inc.
profile.summary: I am a software developer with experience developing backend systems and full stack web applications. I like working on applications that involve developing scaling solutions as well as processing and handling large amounts of data. I am dedicated to creating products that have a well-built and reliable end user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Full Stack
positions.description:
Developed new features as well as optimized and scaled existing services within the main application and supporting services. ParentSquare is a Rails based web service and also provides API endpoints for both iOS and Android apps. Development involved a small cohesive team that provides a high amount of product ownership and autonomy.

Identified, prioritized, and fixed critical bugs and security vulnerabilities. Lead efforts to standardize application requests and promote industry best coding practices and increase test coverage.

Worked closely with the customer service team to identify and resolve customer issues as well as prioritize and implement highly requested features.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Backend
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a Ruby on Rails based RESTful API that delivered lightweight and fast JSON responses. The API supported a single page application front end which provided a fluid end user experience. Additional content was continuously driven through both asynchronous API calls and WebSocket connections.

Developed custom ranking algorithms to provide real time, up to date, and relevant information to the end users. Worked on the back-end system that utlitzed these algorithms to ensure the delivery of relevant information to the end user.

Developed and maintained extensive test coverage by employing test driven development. Tests were written in RSpec and covered all available endpoints following best practices for Rails API testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Systems
positions.description:
Developed RightLink10, the new version of RightScale's server agent, which connects servers managed through RightScale to the RightScale cloud management platform. The RightLink agent is entirely written in Go and is designed to be portable to most Linux, FreeBSD, and Windows operating systems.

Developed accompanying Bash shell and Powershell scripts that augmented the product’s functions through a server's lifecycle. These scripts included support for enabling realtime server monitoring metrics, verbose audit entries and logging, user account and SSH key management, as well as lifecycle operations, which includes boot time, operational and decommission specific services. 

Created and expanded test collateral to validate RightLink10 through a custom built Ruby based automation framework. The integration tests involve multiple Linux and Windows operating systems used across various public and private clouds.

positions.title: Ruby on Rails Developer
positions.description:
Studied Ruby, Rails and related technologies full-time developing applications and mastering
industry best practices through use of pair programming, test-driven development and agile software development.
